ValidationRule.description: Each job must reference exactly one parent matching its integration type.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR(AND(ISPICKVAL(Integration_Type__c, "Payment"), OR(ISBLANK(Payment_Transaction__c), NOT(ISBLANK(Document_Request__c)))), AND(ISPICKVAL(Integration_Type__c, "Document"), OR(ISBLANK(Document_Request__c), NOT(ISBLANK(Payment_Transaction__c)))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Select exactly one parent record matching the integration type.
